title: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Corporate Support Presentation

asr.full_text: We develop programs to meet the growing employment gap in the area of auto. Collision repair, auto technology, advanced welding technology, and bus. Transit technology areas. This center now serves as a national model of a. Successful public-private collaboration. Hillsborough Community College is at the. Cutting edge of training the workforce of tomorrow. And this is another. Important step in ensuring that we're not just moving the needle but that we. Are establishing a pathway forward for the modern jobs in transportation and. Infrastructure. We want to create sustainable paths to careers, jobs that. Ultimately lead to prosperity and wealth for more individuals in our community. So. So today, it is my honor, on behalf of JPMorgan Chase, to announce that we are making a $1. Million investment in support of the Regional Advanced Transportation Center here at Hillsborough. Community College. I absolutely love the welding program here. I'm learning all different types of welding. I'm learning MIG, TIG, I'm even actually doing aluminum right now as we speak. So definitely setting me up for success in the future and not only bettering my life,. But also bettering my children's lives with the program that HCC is giving people here. So not only are you helping your students, but you're helping your students' families as well. How better to prepare a school that will train technicians than to get the industry partners involved? We know what we need. We know what we're looking for. Great, great idea. We are here to provide them with a quality education that prepares them for the workforce. I want to thank JPMorgan Chase for investing in us and really trusting us for their partnership. We will deliver.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents workforce-training and public-private partnership programs at Hillsborough Community College, including automotive, welding, and transit training. The $1 million amount is described as JPMorgan Chase support for the college's Regional Advanced Transportation Center, shown through a check presentation and an identified speaker. The material does not describe a viewer solicitation, promised personal return, required participation, credential request, or other concrete scam mechanism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an educational and workforce-training program, supported by footage of welding instruction and speech describing training for transportation and infrastructure careers.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes workforce-training programs in automotive, welding and bus transit technology.
